scope: Automatic status-page touch, rate-based air mouse, one USB/battery image per device

references.observed: LSM6DS3 angular-rate to BLE relative mouse, fixed gain and loop delay; no stationary bias learning or elapsed-time integration
references.use: Concept comparison only; no source copied. Existing board axis mapping retained.

references.observed: Stationary calibration, exponential smoothing and deadband, with fixed-loop timing
references.use: Independent implementation of fresh-gravity-assisted calibration, time-aware smoothing, subpixel integration and bounded output

references.observed: USB-only BAT node may resemble a connected cell. The example uses learned USB-only voltage history and insertion/removal heuristics.
references.use: Do not treat a static voltage, USB presence, switch position or old battery history as proof of active charging. No charge-current/termination hardware changed.

automatic_touch.method: Existing validated 6x2 DIFF lobe classifier and centroid estimate; heuristic, not native two-contact coordinates
automatic_touch.entry: Status page, awake, air mouse off, connected HID endpoint, no pending button release; real native zero-contact quiet interval then verified chip/FW0100/layout and DIFF quiet baseline
automatic_touch.lifetime: No host command, DTR or 60-second deadline. Fresh-frame watchdog, bounded restore and retry cooldown remain mandatory.
automatic_touch.ownership: Native absolute touch for menus/wake. DIFF owner for status pointer/taps/scroll. No simultaneous native mouse output.
automatic_touch.limits: Close/overlapping contacts may not produce separable lobes. Old labelled recordings do not establish arbitrary-hand or long-term accuracy. A held startup contact or ambiguous/noisy baseline intentionally withholds mouse events.
automatic_touch.writes: Existing allowlisted volatile diagnostic page/DIFF scan commands only; no touch firmware, MTP or calibration-data programming

air_mouse.behavior: Relative angular-rate mouse; existing buttons-bottom portrait and USR1 behavior retained
air_mouse.zero: Fresh accelerometer stability plus bounded gyro spread over at least 980ms; never emit with no valid bias; automatic calibration retry
air_mouse.motion: Actual elapsed time, soft deadband, time-aware Q8 low-pass, fractional movement carry, gap reset and 250 pixels/sec per-axis ceiling
air_mouse.limits: No claim of drift-free operation; slow constant rotation can resemble stationary bias. Existing physical axes retained, not newly hardware-verified.

power.variants: Exactly one image per dongle/peripheral; battery_connected build option removed
power.usb: Physical VBUS retained independently of enumeration or charge-status validity
power.battery_only: Fresh plausible ADC without USB supplies battery percentage after source settling
power.usb_battery_uncertain: Unknown percentage/charging rather than false 100% or a fabricated charge bolt
power.safety: Hardware charge termination is not implemented or guaranteed by this UI firmware. The 230mAh cell maximum permitted charge current remains unverified. This narrow telemetry review is not a circuit safety certification.

verification.method: Portable C tests under sanitizers, actual driver mocked-bus tests, existing trace replay, then five-target GitHub firmware build
verification.manual_device_actions: None in this change; no new sampling window or device flashing
verification.release_grade: Unified automatic-use candidate; not claimed physically long-term validated
